description.zh: 普鲁士在腓特烈·威廉一世与腓特烈大帝治下锻造出'带有国家的军队'：以1723年总执行部（Generaldirektorium）为枢纽、省级军政-王领厅为执行臂膀，容克贵族垄断军官团，国王以内阁谕令（Kabinettsordre）凌驾合议机构之上亲政。此为普鲁士军事官僚制的成型期，现代官僚国家的经典原型。（俾斯麦帝国宰相制属19世纪另一体系。）
description.en: Under Frederick William I and Frederick the Great, Prussia forged 'an army with a state': hubbed on the General Directory (Generaldirektorium, 1723) with provincial War-and-Domains Chambers as executive arms, a Junker-monopolized officer corps, and a king governing personally by cabinet order (Kabinettsordre) above the collegial boards. This is the formative phase of Prussian military bureaucracy. (Bismarck's chancellor system is a distinct 19th-c. order.)
